Visitor skips at element_start level removes entire subtree

```python title="Python"
from html_to_markdown import convert

def main() -> None:
    class _TestVisitor:
        def visit_element_start(self, ctx, *args):  # noqa: ANN001, ANN202, ARG002
            return "skip"
    html = "<div><h1>Title</h1><p>Content</p></div>"
    result = convert(html, visitor=_TestVisitor())
    print(result.content)
```
